sec.title: August 29 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 342)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **August 29** across American network radio, BBC, and CBC, Jay Jostyn & Raymond Edward Johnson busting extortion rackets on *Mr. District Attorney* for Vitalis (1939–1945), vital World War II news broadcasts covering Churchill speeches, Italian air campaigns, and MacArthur's Tokyo occupation preparations (1941–1945), and Lister Sinclair's Canadian domestic satire on *Little Things in Life* (1939–1975):
